term: SD, likelihood comparison and comparative confirmation in #117
definition: SD is a disposition to form beliefs in supernatural agency; T is theism and N naturalism. The displayed conditional probabilities compare SD under those hypotheses using qualitative much-greater-than notation. Confirmation is comparative evidential support for T over N, not by definition actual T or a numeric posterior.
note: No numeric >> threshold, probability measure, hypothesis partition, prior, actual observation or update rule is selected. Disposition is not belief truth. An actual Bayesian application would require independently appropriate probability/conditioning and evidence assumptions; no such calculus or theorem is introduced.
